title: Allegro
identity: Musicnotes item MN0040745 identifies John Tyndall’s alto saxophone and piano arrangement of Fiocco’s Allegro, in C major, 4/4 at quarter note=105, from Belwin Master Solos, Volume 1. Musicnotes lists a separate Bourne/Rascher arrangement; details from that arrangement do not transfer to this one.

evidence.claim: Musicnotes identifies the Tyndall arrangement, key, meter, tempo, instrumentation and Belwin volume, and offers an eight-page solo/accompaniment preview. Pages 1 and 2 were visually inspected.
Distinct Rascher arrangement described as containing dynamic contrasts and technical passages; retailer-generated product description, not score analysis.

score_observations: In the inspected opening excerpt for the Tyndall edition, the alto saxophone rests over an active, continuously moving piano part. In the next visible passage the saxophone enters with slurred moving figures while the piano retains flowing motion. Only the opening two sample pages were inspected; no complete range claim is made.
review_focus: Inference from the inspected excerpt: assess entry after rests and coordination with the piano’s running texture; compare the full arrangement before judging its demands.
collection_flag: Transcription of an 18th-century keyboard work; multiple saxophone arrangements exist.

score_links.description: Musicnotes preview for Tyndall/Belwin edition, eight pages; opening two pages visually inspected.

gaps: Only the opening two sample pages were inspected; later passages and full saxophone range remain unknown.
The separate Bourne/Rascher edition is a different arrangement and is not evaluated here.
